title: 蒸気の風と、琥珀色の航路
author: 灯守 ルカ

en.title: Winds of Steam and the Amber Route
en.premise: In a world where steam engines beat as the heart of civilization, I make my living as a wandering mail carrier. My life changes the day I come into possession of a fragment of the 'Broken Sword'—a relic of a forgotten era—which reveals the path to the 'Final Train' that once reigned over the skies. Guided by the glow of amber sunsets and the fragrant scents of unknown cities, I embark on a journey to the edge of the sky to uncover the truth.

zh.title: 蒸汽之风与琥珀色航路
zh.premise: 在这个以蒸汽机为文明之心的世界里，我是一名四处奔波的邮递员。某日，我偶然得到了旧时代遗物『折断之剑』的碎片，并发现它竟指向了曾经统治天空的『最终列车』。在云隙间绚烂的夕阳与陌生城镇的诱人香气指引下，我为了追寻真相，踏上了前往天空尽头的旅程。
